launch.note: The one home of every per-role launch setting. A role's structured fields are the settings; launch.templates is only the wiring each agent's command follows, and the reader in scripts/paths.sh (pp_route, pp_argv) fills its placeholders and fails before any launch on a malformed entry. A model is a family name, never a version: Claude Code resolves opus, sonnet, haiku and fable itself, and builder-codex-pass.sh resolves a Codex family to the newest model the account lists. A null effort is omitted from the command, never defaulted. fast renders as Codex service_tier=fast or Claude --settings {"fastMode":true}; false is the default tier, and the review and plan roles take it from their /plugin config Fast key only. A role's /plugin config keys (pp_role_option) beat its fields here; a launch's own --model or --effort beats both. A headless role (headless: true) is one a script runs with codex exec or claude -p. Every pane role is unboxed: the plugin ships no pane box, so launch.paneBox is not set.

orchestrator.note: Orchestration only; never implements. Plans with the owner, launches Builders, merges. Cannot be off: it is the session that runs everything.

plan-author.note: The plan main writes before every build: it writes the plan file and nothing else. Main stops once the plan exists; the build starts only on the owner's own go after reading it. Off (planAuthorEnabled=false in /plugin config): no plan, plan-tier.sh prints the --skip-plan line.

plan-judge-sol.note: Judge of the Plan + judge and Panel answers: reads the plan and prints its findings; the planner revises once with them. One round, no judging loop. planJudgeSolAgent=claude (the Claude-only profile sets it) runs it as the read-only Claude pane in claude; off, the other judge judges alone.

plan-judge-fable.note: The Panel answer's second judge, beside plan-judge-sol: a read-only Claude pane on Fable at high that reads the plan and prints its findings; off, the other judge judges alone.

builder.note: One pane per batch in its own worktree, with no advisor, a risky batch included (set-up offers none); builds, runs its own Explore (haiku) and general-purpose (sonnet) subagents and review passes (builder-codex-pass.sh, model from roles.codex-reviewer), hands back a branch. Launched by builder-launch.sh. Cannot be off: with no Builder there is no branch to review or merge.

fixer.note: Not a pane of its own: the Builder's pane on a fix round (builder-fresh-round.sh). The first fix round of a build runs on first (builder: the build's launched Builder model and effort, so it keeps them), every later one on this model and effort; builder in either means the build's launched Builder model or effort. Off (fixerEnabled=false): every fix round keeps the Builder's launched model and effort.

codex-reviewer.note: The review pass. codexReviewerAgent=claude (the Claude-only profile sets it) runs the headless read-only Claude session in claude, on a different family than the Builder's. Fast mode is not set here: it changes what a run costs, so it is the owner's answer (codexReviewerFast in /plugin config, off by default). With a yes the pass preflight needs service_tier = "fast" in the Codex config. Cannot be off: the merge gate needs a GO round file.

review-limits.note: Per Codex review. calls: model calls one review session may make. diffLines: added plus deleted lines in main...HEAD, generated files excluded; a bigger unit is split before review.

seat-liveness.note: read-verdict.sh --state: a seat's background command older than this counts as overdue, not busy, so a hung command cannot hold its driver past the stall line.
